decisions.reason: Because submarine interior lighting is relatively distant and only lightly featured, it is more likely to fall short of aspiration levels, but the firm's growth, R&D capability and maritime customer base give enough slack to keep it for now while learning continues.

A medical examination light builds on the firm's lighting capabilities and institutional customer knowledge, so absent clear signs of failure management would likely view it as close enough to aspiration to retain.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires fit the firm's established industrial offering and certified engineering strengths, making satisfactory performance more likely and reducing pressure to reallocate resources.

The relaunched designer task light is close to the core business and was presented as a popular product, so it most likely exceeds aspiration levels and gives management little reason to search for an alternative.
